💪 5 DUMBBELL ARM EXERCISES

Want more variety in your arm workouts? Try these five dumbbell movements:

1️⃣ Biceps Curl — Biceps
2️⃣ Hammer Curl — Brachialis, brachioradialis & biceps
3️⃣ Concentration Curl — Biceps
4️⃣ Overhead Triceps Extension — Triceps
5️⃣ Lying Triceps Extension — Triceps

✅ Keep your wrists steady.
✅ Avoid swinging the weights.
✅ Choose loads you can control.
✅ Move through a comfortable range of motion.

You don't need to perform all five exercises in one session. Choose movements that suit your goals and ability.
